title: Student Grades Dictionary
prompt:
Create a program that takes a dictionary of student names and their grades as input. The program should calculate the average grade of all students and then print out each student's name along with their grade and a message indicating whether they passed (grade 50 or above) or failed.
Sample Input: {"Alice": 80, "Bob": 30, "Charlie": 60}
Sample Output: Alice: 80 - Passed
Bob: 30 - Failed
Charlie: 60 - Passed
